description: This Java class 'ShoppingCartHelper' provides utility methods for managing shopping cart operations such as adding, modifying, deleting items, handling requirements, and managing agreements within an e-commerce system. It acts as a facade over the ShoppingCart class, simplifying interactions with the cart and integrating with other components like product workers, promotions, and entity queries.

classes.name: ShoppingCartHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to manipulate shopping cart items, handle requirements, agreements, and promotions within an e-commerce system.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds an item to the shopping cart with detailed parameters including product info, reservation, shipping, configuration, and context.

methods.name: addToCartFromOrder
methods.description: Adds items from an existing order to the shopping cart, with options to add all or specific items.

methods.name: addToCartBulk
methods.description: Adds multiple products in bulk based on request parameters, handling quantities and alternative packing.

methods.name: addToCartBulkRequirements
methods.description: Adds requirement items to the cart in bulk, processing multiple rows and facility info.

methods.name: addCategoryDefaults
methods.description: Adds all products in a category based on default quantities defined in ProductCategoryMember.

methods.name: deleteFromCart
methods.description: Removes specified items from the shopping cart based on context keys.

methods.name: modifyCart
methods.description: Updates quantities, descriptions, comments, and other attributes of cart items; handles deletions and promotions.

methods.name: getFeatureAppl
methods.description: Retrieves a product feature application value based on product ID, option field, and feature ID.

methods.name: getRemoveFeatureTypeId
methods.description: Extracts the feature type ID from an option field string.

methods.name: selectAgreement
methods.description: Associates a pricing or purchase agreement with the cart, setting currency and order terms.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for the shopping cart.

methods.name: addOrderTerm
methods.description: Adds an order term to the cart, optionally with a text value.

methods.name: removeOrderTerm
methods.description: Removes an order term from the cart by index.
